outcome_statement: A real, callable Evidence Fusion service combines transcript, timing, tonality, history, and face/body signals into one calibrated confidence estimate for the user's cognitive/emotional state, modality-weighted and calibratable, with a real per-context weight-learning function from labeled outcomes -- domain-independent shared infrastructure every OS consumes.
pain: Every OS today interprets raw signals (words alone, timing alone) independently, with no shared, calibrated way to combine multiple weak signals into one confident read, and no way to learn from real outcomes which signal matters most in which context.
value: One honest, calibrated confidence number instead of five different systems each guessing on their own -- the shared foundation V3/V4/V5 all depend on.
success_metrics: fuseEvidence() and learnWeights() match the proven prototype's (scripts/prototype-evidence-fusion-v2.mjs, 30/30 tests) exact scoring/weighting arithmetic on the same inputs -- verified by direct behavioral proof, not just export existence
failure_metrics: Output drift from the proven prototype on the same input
constraints: BuilderOS system path only -- no agent hand-build
unacceptable_result: Reinvented scoring logic that doesn't match the proven prototype; wiring into a live product surface (out of scope for this mission)
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict

point_model.A: Vision — Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff — corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
